title.zh: v2.17.0 GS-1 升级到 ABI 9：出货音色也有了逐音音准；采样织体的机制全线打通
title.en: v2.17.0 GS-1 moves to ABI 9: per-note tuning on the shipping voice, and the sample-texture path is complete end to end

highlights.zh: **逐音音色变化现在真的作用在出货音色上。** 之前这条变化只对原生合成器生效：GS-1（和弦与主奏的默认音色）的接口只有音高/力度/声像，所以开着采样池时渲染结果与关闭时**逐字节相同**。上游合成核里逐音的音准表、弯音表和逐声部读取一直都在，缺的只是两个 C 出口——补上后核版本升到 ABI 9，适配器暴露 `noteBend` / `setTuningNote`，变化以**逐音微分音**的形式送达（GS-1 没有逐音截止频率）。实测：主奏 0.164 dB 对 0.069 对照（×2.38），与原生路径的 ×2.48 基本一致。
highlights.en: **The per-note timbre variation now reaches the shipping voice.** It only ever applied to the native synths: GS-1 — the default for chords and lead — took pitch, velocity and pan, so with the pool enabled the render was **byte-identical** with and without the nudge. The core's per-note tuning table, its bend table and the per-voice read of them had existed all along; only two C entry points were missing. With them the core is ABI 9, the adapter exposes `noteBend` / `setTunin…

highlights.zh: **采样织体的机制全线打通（还没有曲风使用）。** 适配器首次暴露采样导入（`importSample` / `clearSample`，返回核心自己的返回码），新增一个 `texture` 角色与 `sampleTexture` 音色（核心的采样档、根音 60、一次性播放），并定下一条路由规则：**乐器名**说明「这是录音」，因此在任何轨上都成立；录音在每个 GS-1 实例上只导入一次（离线在接入图之前 `await`，实时在调度器里发出），`fx` 轨的渲染与实时播放都已接上。真录音是内容：现在播的是生成的替身（确定性噪声床 + 瞬态点击），你有素材随时替换。
highlights.en: **The sample-texture path is complete end to end (no genre uses it yet).** The adapter exposes sample import for the first time (`importSample` / `clearSample`, returning the core's own codes), a `texture` role and a `sampleTexture` patch join the tables (the core's sample mode, root 60, one-shot), and one routing rule decides: the **instrument name** says "this is a recording", so it holds on any lane. The recording is imported once per GS-1 instance (awaited before the off…

highlights.zh: **为什么分两次发**：上一版修的是手机播放顺序（会连续切歌），这一版是声音与合成核，两者互不影响，各自可回退。
highlights.en: **Why this is a separate release**: the previous one fixed the phone's play-order button switching tracks without waiting; this one is sound and the synth core. They do not depend on each other, and either can be rolled back alone.
